question: How should the wise practitioner apply this rule to all other cases of enlargement?
premises: A specific rule for enlargement has been stated.
The same method is to be followed.
The wise practitioner is the agent of this action.
inference: The wise practitioner should increase all such cases in this very way by the same rule.
plain_english: In this very way, by the same rule, the wise one should increase all of that.
